Arianespace announces that the launch chronology for Ariane 6, scheduled to place 36 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit on November 23, 2026, was interrupted following a technical event affecting the launcher's ground support systems.
The chronology was stopped before the mobile gantry removal and the start of launcher system operations.
Ariane 6 and its passengers, the 36 Amazon Leo satellites, remain in stable and safe conditions.
Technical teams are assessing the event and preparing for launch operations to resume, with the next launch opportunity no earlier than November 24. Arianespace will provide further updates as soon as they become available.

vid_urls.description:
Et de 10 ! Pour ce 10e lancement Ariane 6 depuis le Centre spatial guyanais, le lanceur européen emportera 36 satellites Amazon LEO. Ariane 6 décollera dans sa configuration à quatre boosters et sera équipée des propulseurs d'appoint à propergol solide P160C.

configuration.description: Kinetica 1 (also known as Lijian-1, Chinese: 力箭一号) is a Chinese solid-propellant light launch vehicle. It is capable of placing about 2 tons into low earth orbit and 1.5 tons into sun-synchronous orbit. It is developed by CAS Space, a subsidiary of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. Kinetica 1 is a light launcher whose first stage seems to be derived from the DF-31 long-range intercontinental ballistic missile. It is 30 m high and has a diameter of 2.65 m, with a liftoff mass of 135 t. It's the largest Chinese solid propellant launcher to date, with four stages with a thrust of 200, 100, 50 and 10 tons respectively. The fairing has a diameter of 3.35 meters.
